_invoicingComment: Invoice generation needs three things this host did not previously touch:
BlobStorage    - where the rendered PDFs are filed (its own 'invoices' container,
NOT the provider-images one every photo endpoint writes to).
Cosmos         - the provider's BUSINESS name and address, which are in their
offering document and nowhere in SQL. Only the provider-lookup
slice is registered; this host still has no SQL infrastructure.
InvoiceStorage - the QueueTrigger's connection. NAMED, and deliberately not
AzureWebJobsStorage: the queue lives on the same account as the
invoice blobs, which is not necessarily the account the Functions
runtime uses for its own bookkeeping.

_comment: LaunchDiscountPercentage 100 is what makes the provider's fee invoice read
'Total due CHF 0.00'. Set it to 0 to start actually billing the Pawfront fee.
The fee PERCENTAGE itself is NOT here - it comes from Payments:PawfrontFeePercentage,
the same value the booking detail and the earnings figures use.
No UID / MWST number for either party: none exists in the schema, and printing an
invented tax identifier on a financial document is worse than omitting the line.
Two Firebase projects, because the provider and pet-parent apps are registered separately.
A device token issued by one project is rejected by the other (SENDER_ID_MISMATCH),
so the notification's audience selects the credential.
Supply the service-account JSON (Firebase Console > Project Settings > Service Accounts >
Generate new private key) ONE of two ways:
CredentialsFilePath   - a local, gitignored file. For development.
CredentialsSecretName - a Key Vault secret name (or LocalSecrets:<name> when
AzureKeyVault:Enabled is false). For deployed environments.
The JSON contains a private key, so it must never be pasted into this file.
